labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks how to contribute and open PRs from a fork; per CONTRIBUTING.md, describe the change in an issue first.

body:
Pull requests to Rich are limited to collaborators, so access or fork PRs can't be enabled for this. To propose the mixed-width fix, please describe the change in a new issue first, following [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md). Any AI-assisted change must also follow [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md). For general questions, use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
